name: higgsfield-media
description: Generates images or video through Higgsfield's hosted MCP server, follows asynchronous jobs, then imports the returned asset into this site's Media library. Connect with agent_plugin_connect and the person's browser sign-in, never an API key. Discover this account's current tools, schemas and model entitlements; the worked model and plan examples are historical, not guarantees. Covers operator write grants, polling without sync:true, connection recovery and media_import_from_url.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Makes AI images with Higgsfield and saves them to your Media library. You sign in to Higgsfield once in your browser.
